reason: CodeQL only recognises CSRF protection from libraries such as csurf. The API defends cookie-authenticated requests by checking Origin (or Referer) against the allow list, a defence listed in the OWASP CSRF Prevention Cheat Sheet, on top of SameSite=Strict cookies.
mitigation: csrfProtection in backend/src/middlewares/security.middleware.ts; tests in backend/tests/integration/auth.routes.test.ts (CSRF protection on cookie requests).
